meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Dask 帮你处理超出内存的 pandas/NumPy 数据:拆成小块并行计算,支持单机多核和跨机器集群,覆盖 DataFrame、Array、Bag、Futures、调度器选择。
howto.when: 当你数据超出内存、需要把 pandas/NumPy 代码扩展到集群,或想并行处理多个文件(如 CSV、Parquet、日志)时触发。

say.text: 我有个 50GB 的 CSV 装不进内存,怎么用 Dask 处理?
帮我把这段 pandas 代码改成 Dask 并行版本。
say.note: Claude 会转换并解释惰性执行与调度器。

say.text: 多个 Parquet 文件要并行聚合,用 Dask 哪个组件?

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you scale pandas/NumPy workflows that exceed memory using Dask: breaking data into chunks, parallel processing on cores or clusters, and covering DataFrames, Arrays, Bags, Futures, and scheduler selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process datasets larger than RAM, scale pandas/NumPy code across clusters, or handle multiple files in parallel (CSV, Parquet, logs), among others.

say_en.text: I have a 50 GB CSV too large for memory; how do I process it with Dask?
say_en.note: Claude will show dd.read_csv chunking and compute.

say_en.text: Convert this pandas code to a Dask parallel version.
say_en.note: Claude will adapt it and explain lazy execution.

say_en.text: Which Dask component should I use to aggregate many Parquet files in parallel?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest DataFrame and groupby.
